info.name: Gotowebinar Webhooks API
info.description: Operations tagged Webhooks across 2 of this provider's published API definitions: gotowebinar-openapi.yml, gotowebinar-webhooks-openapi.yml. Each path carries the servers of the definition it was published in.

request.description: This creates a new secret key per application. It takes an optional validFrom value, a date time in ISO8601 format, e.g. 2019-07-01T22:00:00Z. The secret key will be activated at the given date. If validFrom is not passed, the secret key will be activated immediately. The secret key is used to generate a signature for events published to the callback url.
